lines: Mind the grindstone. It has no patience for wandering fingers.
Give the grindstone room. Weapons works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the grindstone. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was just near the grindstone, trying to keep the day sensible.
Keep clear of the edge work.
Hello. If you brought a weapon, set it down gently.
You caught me while the steel is cooling.
Stand away from the grindstone unless sparks improve your mood.
Good timing. The blade is quiet for the moment.
Come closer slowly and keep your hands sensible.
I have a moment before the next edge needs arguing with.
Welcome. Do not touch anything that looks ready to object.
The forge is hot and the day is sharper than I like.
Speak up. The grindstone has been telling the same story all morning.
Hello there. If this is about repairs, show me the damage.
I was checking balance. People rarely pass as easily.
Stand on the safe side and tell me what you need.
Good to see you with your weapon lowered.
You have my attention until the steel asks for it back.
